meta.name: Quality control
meta.about: Every safeguard on what enters HAX, generated from the workflow files on each repo's default branch, so only checks that are merged and running appear: 84 blocking gates, 6 advisory checks, 25 scheduled jobs and 7 Claude scheduled tasks. Planned tiles are open pull requests. Element test suites include axe accessibility tests where an element has them; whole-project accessibility is covered by the weekly sweep, not a blocking gate.

qg_block.desc: 84 checks that fail a pull request when they fail, in at least one repo; whether a failing check stops the merge is up to each repo's branch rules. Each is read from the repo's workflow files on its default branch, so only checks that are merged and running appear.

qg_adv.desc: 6 checks that run on pull requests but don't stop a merge (continue-on-error, warning only or report only), plus 1 planned checks still in open pull requests. ESLint stays here until it blocks.

qg_sched.desc: 25 GitHub Actions jobs on a schedule and 7 Claude scheduled tasks. Nothing auto-merges: every PR waits for review, and every flag lands in the unified issue queue.

q_a11y_modes.desc: Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_admin_contrast.desc: Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_element_api_snapshot.desc: The front-end API of authorable elements doesn't change, so all content ever made keeps working. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_lint.desc: Code follows the repo's lint rules, such as no optional chaining or browser alert / confirm / prompt dialogs in webcomponents. Fails the pull request when it fails in create, haxcms-nodejs, webcomponents.

q_no_new_non_baseline_apis.desc: A pull request adds no new use of a browser API that isn't Baseline widely available, unless marked as a deliberate exception. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_script_tests.desc: The repo's build and maintenance scripts keep working. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_stylelint.desc: CSS follows the stylesheet rules. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_test_all_elements.desc: Every element's test suite passes in Chromium; element suites include axe accessibility tests where an element has them. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_format_check.desc: Formatting stays consistent (Prettier). Reports without failing the pull request in webcomponents. Fails the pull request when it fails in create, haxcms-nodejs.

q_gallery_build.desc: The component gallery still builds. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_cla.desc: Every contributor has signed the contributor license agreement. Fails the pull request when it fails in create, haxcms-mcp, haxcms-nodejs, haxcms-php, issues, praw, webcomponents.

q_codeql.desc: Code with known vulnerability patterns doesn't merge. Fails the pull request when it fails in create, haxcms-mcp, haxcms-nodejs, haxcms-php, praw, webcomponents.

q_contrast_design_systems.desc: Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_baseline_only_shrinks.desc: A pull request can remove known failures from a check's baseline, never add them. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_color_contrast_of_changed_elements.desc: Text in the demos of the elements a pull request touches meets WCAG AA contrast in light and dark mode. Known failures are baselined, and the baseline can only shrink. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_palette_roles_self_test.desc: The check proves it can fail: a planted fault has to be caught before the real run counts. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_palette_roles.desc: Each palette's own pairings (links on the page surface, text on each palette color) keep contrast, and data-palette really switches the palette (all seven colors resolve, no two palettes alike), in every palette, scheme and design system. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_dark_motion.desc: Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_ddd_token_lint.desc: Only real DDD design tokens are referenced, and the token export stays current. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_audit.desc: Dependencies with known security advisories are caught. Reports without failing the pull request in haxcms-php. Fails the pull request when it fails in create, haxcms-nodejs, webcomponents.

q_gallery_audit.desc: The component gallery still builds. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_gallery_contrast.desc: The component gallery still builds. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_hax_ui_admin_contract.desc: Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_haxschema.desc: Changed HAX-capable elements have a valid HAX editing schema that edits only what the element declares. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_pseudo_locale_and_rtl_layout.desc: Changed elements still lay out with long pseudo-locale strings and right to left. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_unused_code_knip.desc: Unused files, exports and dependencies are found. Reports without failing the pull request in webcomponents.

q_memory_leaks.desc: Changed elements don't leak memory when added and removed. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_dependency_licenses.desc: No dependency under an incompatible license enters the repo, the project stays Apache-2.0, and element source files carry the license header. Fails the pull request when it fails in create, haxcms-nodejs, haxcms-php, praw, webcomponents.

q_locale_guard.desc: Feature PRs change English strings only; translations come from the nightly job. Reports without failing the pull request in webcomponents.

q_render_benchmarks.desc: Render performance of changed elements is measured on the PR. Reports without failing the pull request in webcomponents.

q_color_vision_action_pairs.desc: Accept and dismiss pairs (save vs cancel, keep vs delete) stay tellable apart in greyscale and with color vision deficiencies. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_no_typescript.desc: No TypeScript source enters elements/; HAX ships JavaScript with no compile step. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_tests_poll_don_t_sleep.desc: No test gains a fixed sleep; tests wait for the condition they need. Sleeps that predate the rule are baselined, and the baseline only shrinks. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_shadow_boundary_aria_references.desc: No element gains an id reference (aria-labelledby, aria-controls, for and the like) that points across a shadow boundary or at nothing. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_a11y_collapse_heading_button.desc: No element, demo or HAX schema gains an a11y-collapse whose whole heading doesn't open it. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_package_names.desc: Every element package is named @haxtheweb/<folder>. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_element_docs_setup.desc: Every element ships its documentation data, and its build regenerates it. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_es_modules.desc: No shipped element code gains CommonJS; elements are ES modules. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_secrets.desc: No committed file holds a key, token or private key; a value that has to ship is listed by hash with why. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_incorrect_is_purple_never_red.desc: No wrong-answer style is painted red; incorrect is purple. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_tracking_is_declared.desc: Every element that sends xAPI declares what it sends, so the person tracked can see it. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.
